author: reek
body: The envelope id is sha256 of the encoded payload -- content- addressed, deterministic, idempotent. Replay is detected by id collision; the envelope signature covers (id, fingerprint, kind-tag) so payload integrity follows transitively from id.

author: reek
body: Many functions here are split into small helpers to keep each if-else single-armed and dodge the let-with-multi-arm-if parser landmine.

author: reek
body: pump-outbound walks repo.outbox first, then repo.verdict-outbox. If the full annotation list ships, the outbox is drained; same for the verdict outbox. Partial sends leave the remainder for the next cycle.

author: reek
body: The envelope sig proves the message was signed by the named sender; verify-annotation against the keyring then proves the inner annotation's authorship. Both must hold for the receiver to trust the payload.

author: reek
body: dispatch-inbound is the per-message receive callback. For capability/control messages it returns the state unchanged -- the existing handlers see those in their own pipelines. For the knowledge-publication kinds it walks a series of guards: envelope verification, annotation verification against the keyring, trust score against the threshold. Any guard that fails drops the message silently.
